slide1.headline: Claude Mythos Sparks AI Security Debate
slide1.subtitle: Anthropic Restricts Release of Advanced Cyber Model

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: On 13 Apr 2026, Anthropic restricted the release of its advanced cyber model.
The decision was made due to potential AI security risks.
This move has sparked a debate about AI security in the industry.
The model, Claude Mythos, has raised concerns about its potential impact on cybersecurity.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The restriction of the model's release highlights the growing concern about AI security.
As AI models become more advanced, the potential risks to cybersecurity increase.
The industry must balance the benefits of AI with the need to ensure security and safety.
Questions to consider: What are the potential risks of advanced AI models to cybersecurity? How can the industry balance the benefits of AI with the need to ensure security?
